**3B.10 Research Note: Abiy Ahmed in 2024**

Overall: **mixed, but leaning negative**. Ethiopia ended 2024 with some de-escalatory regional diplomacy and a few institution-building efforts, but domestically the year was marked by emergency rule, major civilian violence, mass detention, and a severe crackdown on dissent. On balance, I do **not** find evidence that citizens were left clearly safer than they were inherited in early 2024.

- **Ethiopia extends state of emergency in Amhara** | Reuters via KELO | 2024-02-02 | https://kelo.com/2024/02/02/ethiopia-extends-state-of-emergency-in-amhara/  
  - Parliament extended emergency rule amid insurgent fighting, hundreds of deaths, and abuse allegations. This is strong evidence that Abiy inherited and continued a dangerous domestic-security environment rather than leaving it safer by early 2024.  
  - QIDs: `3B.10`  
  - Also informs: `3B.5`, `3B.6`, `3B.9`

- **Ethiopia’s military executes dozens in Amhara region** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-04-04 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/04/04/ethiopia-military-executes-dozens-amhara-region  
  - HRW reported Ethiopian forces summarily killed dozens of civilians in Merawi. This is direct evidence that domestic safety deteriorated for civilians during 2024 rather than improving.  
  - QIDs: `3B.10`  
  - Also informs: `3B.1`, `3B.2`, `3B.7`, `3B.9`

- **Ethiopia: Merawi killings should be independently investigated** | Amnesty International | 2024-04-12 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/04/ethiopia-merawi-killings-should-be-independently-investigated/  
  - Amnesty said ENDF soldiers rounded up local men in Merawi and shot and killed scores after fighting with Fano, with no credible government effort to ensure justice. This is direct evidence against a safer domestic-security environment.  
  - QIDs: `3B.10`  
  - Also informs: `3B.1`, `3B.2`, `3B.7`, `3B.9`

- **Ethiopia: Army attacks health care in Amhara conflict** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-07-03 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/07/03/ethiopia-army-attacks-health-care-amhara-conflict  
  - HRW documented seizures of ambulances, hospital raids, and attacks on medical neutrality, showing ongoing harm to civilians and wounded people. This undercuts any claim that domestic insecurity was meaningfully reduced.  
  - QIDs: `3B.10`  
  - Also informs: `3B.1`, `3B.2`, `3B.7`, `3B.9`

- **Ethiopia: Fighting, abuses putting Sudanese refugees at risk** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-10-17 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/10/17/ethiopia-fighting-abuses-putting-sudanese-refugees-risk  
  - HRW said Sudanese refugees in camps faced killings, beatings, looting, forced labor, and pressure to relocate unsafely. That is strong evidence that vulnerable groups were less safe, not more safe, by late 2024.  
  - QIDs: `3B.10`  
  - Also informs: `3B.7`, `3B.1`, `3B.9`

- **Ethiopia: End the month-long arbitrary detention of thousands in Amhara Region** | Amnesty International | 2024-11-06 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/11/ethiopia-end-the-month-long-arbitrary-detention-of-thousands-in-amhara-region/  
  - Amnesty reported thousands of civilians were rounded up into makeshift detention camps. This is strong evidence that the domestic environment became more coercive and less safe.  
  - QIDs: `3B.10`  
  - Also informs: `3B.5`, `3B.6`, `3B.8`, `3B.9`

- **Ethiopia authorities suspend three rights groups** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-12-02 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/ethiopia-authorities-suspend-three-rights-groups  
  - HRW said the government suspended three rights groups while Abiy praised reforms. This is mixed rhetorically, but operationally it shows the state continued to punish civic actors rather than making citizens safer.  
  - QIDs: `3B.10`  
  - Also informs: `3B.4`, `3B.5`, `3B.8`, `3B.9`

- **UN agencies and Ethiopian government launch Durable Solutions Strategy for internal displacement** | UN Ethiopia / UNHCR | 2024-11-11 | https://ethiopia.un.org/en/283776-ethiopia-launches-national-strategy-implement-solutions-pathways-internal-displacement  
  - The government and UN launched a strategy for voluntary return, local integration, and reintegration of IDPs. This is the best positive institutional evidence, but it is a plan, not proof that citizens were actually safer by year-end.  
  - QIDs: `3B.10`  
  - Also informs: `3B.7`, `3B.4`, `3B.6`

- **UN Women, partners deliver training on Gender-Responsive Reintegration Service to Migrant Women Returnees** | United Nations in Ethiopia | 2024-07-26 | https://ethiopia.un.org/en/277273-un-women-partners-deliver-training-gender-responsive-reintegration-service-migrant-women  
  - UN Women and the Ministry of Women and Social Affairs trained stakeholders on safer reintegration services for migrant women returnees. This is positive but narrow, and it does not offset the broader security deterioration.  
  - QIDs: `3B.10`  
  - Also informs: `3B.7`, `3B.4`, `3B.6`

- **UNICEF Ethiopia: Second phase of PROSPECTS launched in Ethiopia** | UNICEF Ethiopia | 2024-03-21 | https://www.unicef.org/ethiopia/press-releases/second-phase-prospects-launched-ethiopia-empowering-refugees-idps-and-host  
  - The program aimed to support refugees, IDPs, and host communities through education, livelihoods, and protection. This is constructive, but it is programmatic and limited relative to the scale of harm documented elsewhere.  
  - QIDs: `3B.10`  
  - Also informs: `3B.7`, `3B.4`, `3B.6`

- **Abiy says he has ‘no intention’ of going to war with Somalia** | Associated Press via CityNews | 2024-02-06 | https://kitchener.citynews.ca/2024/02/06/ethiopias-leader-plays-down-fears-of-conflict-with-somalia-over-a-planned-naval-port/  
  - Abiy publicly framed peace with Somalia as mutually beneficial and tried to lower tensions with Egypt as well. This is the clearest positive evidence that at least one major regional crisis was de-escalated in public rhetoric.  
  - QIDs: `3B.10`  
  - Also informs: `2B.6`, `2B.7`

- **Ankara Declaration** | Republic of Türkiye Directorate of Communications | 2024-12-12 | https://www.iletisim.gov.tr/English/haberler/detay/ethiopia-somalia-ankara-declaration-under-facilitation-of-republic-of-turkiye  
  - Ethiopia and Somalia agreed to respect sovereignty, set aside disputes, and cooperate. This is strong evidence that one external crisis off-ramp was successfully used, but it does not outweigh the domestic violence record.  
  - QIDs: `3B.10`  
  - Also informs: `2B.7`, `2B.6`

**Assessment**

- **Negative domestic trend dominates.** The biggest harms in 2024 were internal: Amhara emergency rule, civilian killings, arbitrary detentions, attacks on health care, and repression of rights groups.
- **Positive material is real but partial.** There was some diplomatic de-escalation with Somalia and some institutional work on displacement and women’s reintegration.
- **Search gap:** I did **not** find credible evidence that Abiy left citizens broadly safer from political violence, intergroup violence, displacement, and preventable insecurity than he inherited them. The evidence points to continued or worsened domestic danger, with only limited positive off-ramps in specific subdomains.
